title: KnowledgeEmissionV1
description: MBR-101: a bounded, typed proposal to persist durable memory, submitted via membrane_knowledge_propose and persisted verbatim by ProposalStore. `text` is the canonical content field (the server reads emission.text ?? emission.content and re-stores with `text`). Provenance is an open metadata map so future fields do not fork the contract, but schemaVersion, kind, and text are always required. Canonical Rust source of truth: engine/crates/membrane-protocol/src/types.rs (KnowledgeEmissionV1).

kind.description: Emission discriminator, e.g. fact, decision, preference, lesson.

provenance.description: Open metadata map: source refs, confidence, tags. Additional properties permitted by design.
